# installer — LLM doc index (pinned: 0.3.20)
# One line per file; regenerate the pin on release. Read files at the tag that matches
# the deployed chart (chart version == the repo tag, plain semver, no v prefix; the
# chart version is also the Installer CRD's served version, v0-3-20).
docs/index.md: the map — what the umbrella installer is + links to the whole bundle
docs/overview.md: how it works — bootstrap vs composition mode, Pass A/Pass B gating, the self-reconcile loop, the three teardown hooks
docs/usage.md: the ONE canonical install, surgical upgrade semantics, day-2 CR editing, uninstall, the agent-only profile
docs/configuration.md: the whole values surface — features, exposure, componentValues, registryAuth, vertexAI, localModel, hitlApproval, bootstrap
docs/api.md: the generated Installer CRD (crdgen from values.schema.json), emitted CompositionDefinitions/Compositions, component-pins as version source of truth
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples
docs/release.md: how a release ships — plain-semver tag → canonical release-oci → GHCR; what a version bump means downstream (GVK migration)
docs/log.md: curated history since the krateo-platformops migration (0.3.x)
examples/bootstrap-install/README.md: the canonical bare-cluster install, NodePort exposure, agent tiers off
examples/bootstrap-install/values.yaml: the values file — helm install -f
examples/component-overrides/README.md: componentValues deep-merge overrides at install time or on the live Installer CR
examples/component-overrides/values.yaml: the values file — helm install -f / kubectl patch
# Chart source (authoritative for every claim above):
chart/values.yaml: defaults + inline design notes for the whole values surface
chart/values.schema.json: the strict typed contract — and the source the Installer CRD is generated from
chart/files/component-pins.yaml: the tested-together component set — versions, deps, tiers, feature gates, wiring flags
chart/templates/definitions.yaml: Pass A — CompositionDefinition registration
chart/templates/compositions.yaml: Pass B — gated Composition emission + all render-time wiring
chart/templates/httproutes.yaml: Gateway API HTTPRoute per exposed component (exposure.type=Gateway); CRD-gated, inert without Gateway API CRDs
chart/templates/self-bootstrap.yaml: self-registration, the Installer CR, lookup RBAC, the post-install/post-upgrade hook
chart/templates/_helpers.tpl: the gating/exposure helpers (crdExists, depsReady, dependentsGone, lbip, nodeip, peerurl, hostname, svcname, componentsYaml, fillPath)
chart/templates/ordered-teardown.yaml: HOOK 1 — reverse-dependency drain of the component tree
chart/templates/bootstrap-teardown.yaml: HOOK 2 — full-footprint drain before engine removal
chart/templates/post-delete-cleanup.yaml: HOOK 3 — post-delete sweep of non-helm-owned leftovers
chart/values-agent-only.yaml: the agent-only install profile
docs/runbooks/kind-default-profile.md: default/portal install (portal + observability, agents off) on a local kind cluster — public charts, no credentials, pinned NodePorts
docs/runbooks/kind-agent-only-profile.md: agent-only install (kagent + autopilot, portal off) on a local kind cluster — registryAuth, vertexAI/localModel, autopilot turns the rest on
docs/runbooks/kind-full-profile.md: full-profile install (portal + observability + agent fleet) on a local kind cluster — kind config, registryAuth, vertexAI, exposure, pinned NodePorts
examples/kind-full-profile/README.md: full-profile kind values — precondition + helm install -f
examples/kind-full-profile/values-full.yaml: the full-profile values file (all feature tiers on)
examples/agent-gateway/README.md: features.agentGateway with a two-tier RBAC split over the fleet — what the installer installs and wires, and how to verify each layer
examples/agent-gateway/values.yaml: the agent-gateway profile — endpoint/tool/delegation rules under componentValues.agentgateway-policies
